en: The postcard front (image 2) displays a hand-colored panoramic view of a historic European town, labeled 'Fågelperspektiv af Sundsvall.' Visibly, there is a prominent church with a tall spire and various period buildings. The text area is heavily handwritten in Swedish. The back (image 1) is traditionally formatted for postal use, written in Swedish, and addressed to an individual in Göteborg. It bears a green Swedish stamp, postmarked 'SUNDSVALL.'
